name: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)
benefit_summary: All-inclusive, cashless healthcare treatment for Ex-Servicemen pensioners, war widows, and their dependents through military hospitals and civilian empaneled facilities.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) guidelines.
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
